text:
860 African American students enrolled at River Rouge High School in 2024-25
River Rouge High School enrolled 860 African American students in the 2024-25 school year, 4.1% more than the previous year, the Michigan Department of Education said.
Data showed River Rouge High School enrolled 987 students during the 2024-25 school year. African American students comprised 87.1% of the student body, the most represented ethnicity at the school.
The school is in School District of the City of River Rouge School District, with a central office in River Rouge.
Of the five schools in School District of the City of River Rouge School District, River Rouge High School had the highest enrollment of African American students in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, including $19.5 billion from the School Aid Fund. It set per-pupil funding at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. The budget maintained free school meals and included full funding for pre-K and community college.
